//: Emulator-only Firebase config for the CI integration tier. Deliberately separate from firebase-hosting/firebase.json, which describes the deployed project — this one exists so `firebase emulators:exec` can run from backend/ without pulling in Hosting.
//rules: No `firestore` block on purpose. Security rules govern client SDKs; this tier drives firestore_repo through the server SDK, which bypasses rules entirely — so including them would prove nothing, and firebase.json cannot reference ../firestore.rules from here anyway. Rules are asserted separately in tests/test_security_controls.py.
